added.member: og.procgen.poissonDisk, bsp, wfc, worley, plant, fracture
added.summary: Supply authored Poisson regions, holes, retained points, density and variable separation; BSP writable cells and retained rooms; WFC per-cell allowed tiles; Worley feature sites; plant trunk curves and custom foliage geometry; explicit Voronoi fracture sites. Offline generators and runtime use the same Rust mechanisms and validation. Model plant and fracture blocks accept the corresponding authored geometry and sites.

breaking.change: Automatic site placement now uses the cook's shared Mitchell best-candidate sampler, including impact clustering; it no longer falls back to sites outside the mesh. The same seed may therefore produce different shards than the former runtime-only sampler.
breaking.fix: Recook generated fracture assets and rebuild games together. Supply explicit sites when a design requires fixed cut centres; insufficient interior sites fail instead of using an alternate sampler.

breaking.change: Descriptors with authored buffers use the generated binary wire on both hosts.
breaking.fix: Regenerate and rebuild host bindings together; game TypeScript continues to pass the generated descriptor. No JSON-wire fallback remains.
